theme: multiface administrative records and operational identification
question: Do whole face modules bind beyond site/type/length margins and copying, and what carrier operations could the observed architecture implement?

Copied bundle collisions are 423 versus 141.192 under full-module allocation (Holm p=.001). The W034/W700 depletion expresses face-role occupancy: 103 faces contain both codes; preserving W700 slot roles reduces expected cross-face exposure from 23.485 to .957 and leaves no adjusted sign-pair maximum below .05. Copying persists (423 versus 190.940, Holm p=.002). A standing-capacity-token life cycle and identity, issuer, package, commodity and canonical receipt rivals have explicit independent physical predictions. challenge: Harappa and copied face modules dominate; one graph component has 222 of 312 prototypes. Declared side counts disagree for five primary objects. The selected prototype-bag law differs from original-copy-bag permutation then deduplication. Broad administrative field labels are observationally equivalent.
remedy: Freeze intact-module allocation before outcomes, keep all faces and aliases before filters, use full-search maxima and 10-test Holm adjustment, preserve original endpoint, add dated post-outcome W700-role control, retain independent exact counterexample, and specify carrier histories and controlled physical observations.
